notes: Each cue binds to a concrete subtitle start/end range when subtitle events exist.
Knowledge points are aligned to the closest subtitle segment by keyword overlap, with ordered fallback.

designDirectives: Storyboard intent must guide layout hierarchy, color emphasis, and motion pacing.
Course production workflow text must not appear in the learner-facing slide canvas.
Animations must serve comprehension of teaching content, not decorative spectacle.

interactiveScreens.title: 渲染状态调试试验场
interactiveScreens.storyPurpose: Let learners manipulate ShaderGUI property grouping variables as a subpage of the current lesson, without consuming a main slide number.

layoutIntent.readingPath: parent lesson -> exploration controls -> linked feedback -> return to lesson

visualComposition.aspectRatio: full viewport lab surface with 7% safe margin

frameGrid.columns: left controls 36%, right live material-panel feedback 64%
frameGrid.anchor: live feedback panel is the visual center; controls stay left

midground.subject: material panel preview and code snippet

visualComposition.negativeSpace: space between controls and feedback prevents the lab from feeling like a form
visualComposition.readingDirection: breadcrumb -> controls -> live feedback -> return to lesson
visualComposition.safeArea: no content under footer/player controls; keep return path visible

paletteIntent.contrastRole: use emerald for active controls and cyan for linked feedback

realtimeInteractionCues.feedback: Render the lab as a child route of the parent lesson.
realtimeInteractionCues.purpose: Keep exploration outside the pxx slide sequence.

realtimeInteractionCues.feedback: Visible properties, risk level, explanation, and code snippet update immediately.
realtimeInteractionCues.purpose: Show why grouping and conditional display reduce cognitive load.

realtimeInteractionCues.feedback: Learner returns to the current lesson without changing the slide range.
realtimeInteractionCues.purpose: Preserve pxx as the main course spine.

designDirectives: Exploration pages are child routes of parent slides and must not appear in slides.json.
Use interaction-necessity-gate evidence before adding the exploration route.
The exploration must provide a clear return path to its parent lesson.

interactiveScreens.title: 做题页
interactiveScreens.storyPurpose: Let learners answer one focused question at a time, with randomized question order, randomized options, automatic progression, and a final score review.

layoutIntent.readingPath: navigation -> current question -> answer controls -> submit -> next question or score card

frameGrid.columns: single centered card, max readable width
frameGrid.rows: breadcrumb, question header, answer list, action row, score review
frameGrid.anchor: current question card anchors the center; score card replaces it after completion

visualComposition.negativeSpace: generous margins around the card keep the learner focused on one decision
visualComposition.readingDirection: breadcrumb -> question type/progress -> question stem -> options -> submit
visualComposition.safeArea: keep all answer controls above fold on common laptop viewport

cameraPlan.beatMotion: card content changes, frame remains stable

paletteIntent.contrastRole: use emerald for active choices and correct feedback, rose for remediation feedback

realtimeInteractionCues.feedback: Question order is randomized when entering or restarting the quiz.
realtimeInteractionCues.purpose: Prevent answer memorization by fixed order.

realtimeInteractionCues.feedback: Each visible question renders options in a randomized order.
realtimeInteractionCues.purpose: Keep option display data-driven while preserving answer identity by id.

realtimeInteractionCues.feedback: Selected options update local answer state without page reload.
realtimeInteractionCues.purpose: Single and multiple choice interactions stay visibly responsive.

realtimeInteractionCues.feedback: Compute correctness and advance to the next question automatically.
realtimeInteractionCues.purpose: Keep the quiz focused on one decision at a time.

realtimeInteractionCues.feedback: Show final score, review states, restart, practice, and navigation actions.
realtimeInteractionCues.purpose: Close the assessment loop after all questions are answered.

designDirectives: The 做题页 UI must show one active question card at a time.
Question and option order must be randomized without changing answer identity.
Submission advances automatically to the next question.
The score card must provide restart, practice, and return navigation.

_validation.cueBindingPolicy: subtitle segment indexes bind to concrete timecodes after audio generation
_validation.realtimeInteractionPolicy: user actions and state changes bind to concrete Vue event handlers in QuizView
